sections.heading: Dropdown
paragraphs: A dropdown is a select control: a trigger field that opens a menu of options.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Dropdown is built from three components: DropdownTrigger (the field), DropdownMenu (the option list, made of List item instances) and Dropdown (the two combined, collapsed or expanded).

sections.heading: Components
paragraphs: The field showing the selected value or placeholder.

sections.heading: Patterns
paragraphs: Search row at the top of the menu (Show Search).
A clear icon in the trigger (Clearable).
These are example compositions on the page, built from the trigger and menu — not variants of Dropdown.

sections.heading: Anatomy
paragraphs: •   ① Value — the selected option, or placeholder text.
•   ② Chevron — points down when closed and rotates 180° when open.
•   ④ Option — a List item instance.
Not shown: the clear icon (Clearable), the search row (Show Search) and the group label (Grouped).

sections.heading: Sizes
paragraphs: The trigger is 320px wide at every size; the menu opens below it at the same width.

sections.heading: Main elements
paragraphs: •   Shows the selected option, or placeholder text ("Select an option") when nothing is selected.
•   Loading — "Loading options…" with a loading icon.

sections.heading: States
paragraphs: •   Trigger — Default, Hover, Focused, Disabled, Error and Read-only (no chevron).
•   Expanded — the trigger takes the focus border and the chevron rotates 180°.
See the Style tab for how each state looks.

sections.heading: Related
paragraphs: •   List item — each menu option is a List item instance.

sections.heading: Color
paragraphs: Swatches are bound to the live tokens.
The chevron uses icon/color/default from the icons collection; Read-only has no chevron.

sections.heading: Menu
paragraphs: Group label, loading and empty text

sections.heading: DropdownTrigger — 21 variants
paragraphs: Size (3) × State (6) collapsed, plus one Expanded variant per size.

sections.heading: Dropdown
paragraphs: A dropdown is a select control: a trigger field that opens a menu of options.

sections.heading: What the design system provides
paragraphs: •   A Focused state with a focus border on the trigger.
•   Disabled, Error and Read-only trigger states.
•   Loading and Empty menu states with text messages.
•   Trigger heights of 32, 40 and 48px — all above the 24×24px AA target minimum (WCAG 2.5.8).

sections.heading: Development considerations
paragraphs: •   Placeholder text must not replace a visible label (WCAG rules SEM-002) — pair the dropdown with a label.
•   In the Error state, give a text error message, not just a red border — and set aria-invalid.
•   Disabled dropdowns must not receive keyboard focus.
•   The dropdown must be fully operable by keyboard.

sections.heading: Design recommendations
paragraphs: Automated contrast check — WCAG 2.x relative luminance (sRGB), for every theme combination. Minimums: 4.5:1 for value and placeholder text, 3:1 for disabled text, borders and the chevron. Note: project-a / light is measured against the current surface/bg/default, which resolves to blue because of the gray/50 token.
The menu surface relies on its border and drop shadow to separate from the page.
